cases.name: test_retained_stdout_after_leader_exit_obeys_timeout_and_closes_writer
cases.actual: Detached empty-environment writer retains stdout and writes a known synthetic marker to it. Leader exits 0; configured 0.5-second timeout performs real STOP/tree closure within the test's 5-second completion bound. Receipt is timed_out, stdout SHA matches exactly, no downstream dispatch, only closed-tree failure admission.

cases.name: test_ready_drift_refuses_go_and_stops_only_the_owned_worker
cases.actual: Real blocked READY precedes injected controller runtime veto, actual script-byte change, or actual claim.json GPU change. User-code marker stays absent; one actual STOP confirms own tree. Runtime refusal leaves RUNNING; pre-mark input/claim refusals leave LAUNCHING. No business failure/admission, no receipt publication.

cases.name: test_timeout_sigterm_zero_never_becomes_passed
cases.actual: Real leader handles SIGTERM by exiting 0. Timeout still closes escaped writer, keeps worker return code 0, publishes a non-completed terminal and timed_out receipt, invokes once-only failure admission, never fixer/reset/pre/training.

cases.name: test_actual_supervisor_loss_holds_without_second_stop_or_replay
cases.actual: SIGKILL uses the captured private supervisor pidfd only. Writer stays alive; action remains RUNNING/no terminal, claim FSM unchanged, no receipt or failure count. Re-entry HOLDs without a new Popen or a second STOP. Finally cleans owned writer.

cases.name: test_unreturned_actual_ready_is_hold_not_not_started_or_replay
cases.actual: After actual READY and own worker pidfd capture, injected SupervisionUncertain prevents handle return. No GO or automatic STOP, LAUNCHING remains open, no terminal/receipt; re-entry cannot replay. Finally signals only retained own pidfds.
